You don't have belly fat because you lack knowledge. You have belly fat because you don't have the time to work out and eat right. You have a job, maybe you have kids, and you think it's impossible to find the time. But you can find the time without sacrificing anything. In this video I give you six ways to do it, and if you use all six, I would say most of you guys will get back 10 hours a week or more.

Get your free six pack preview and AI workout plan:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro18-make-time

The 6 ways:
1. Talk instead of typing with Wispr Flow, an AI dictation app. You hold down a button, you talk, and it types it out for you. The average person types about 40 words a minute on their phone, but you talk at about 150, so everything you write gets done 3 to 4 times faster. That's about 20 minutes of your day back. There's a free version, and the paid version is $15 a month.
2. Work out at home, not a gym. For most people the gym is 20 to 40 minutes of commute every time you go. All you need is a yoga mat, push-up handles, a pair of light dumbbells, a kettlebell, an ab wheel and a jump rope, and you can get all of that for under $100. I still pay for a gym membership and I work out 7 days a week, but if time is a reason you're not working out, then the gym is the wrong choice for you right now. Start at home.
3. Use a meal prep service and stop cooking your own meals. That's going to save you 2 or 3 hours every week. Meals are about $8 each and every meal has the calories and the macros right on the label. If you're making decent money and you're still cooking all your own food, you're wasting your time.
4. Buy a robot lawn mower. If you have a yard, you're probably spending 2 to 4 hours a week mowing it. A robot mower costs about $1,000 to $2,500, and a lawn service is $3,000 to $6,000 a year.
5. Let the car drive itself. Buy a Tesla or take robotaxis. The average American spends about an hour a day in the car. That's 7 hours a week you can get back. Robotaxis are in Austin where I live.
6. Use AI to do your work for you. This is the biggest one. If you're in school, have AI do the busywork, and use a paid Claude plan, not the free version. If you work, give Claude the most boring and time consuming parts of your job, then do that with one new task every week. AI built the entire Abs By AI app, it does my bookkeeping and it edits my videos. It's saving me at least 10 hours a week.

Add all of this up and it's well over 10 hours a week. And you only need about 2 and a half hours a week to work out for 20 minutes every single day. So you're not too busy to get in shape.
